name: Cross-tenant data leak
description: Defective access control, query bug, or shared cache returns one tenant's data to another. Class-incident scope.

name: API abuse / scraping / DoS
description: Unrate-limited or weakly-authed APIs scraped, abused for credential stuffing, or weaponised for DoS.

name: Sub-processor breach
description: A sub-processor (analytics, AI, email) is breached and customer data is exposed. You remain responsible under GDPR.

name: Major outage breaches SLA
description: Cloud-region failure, deploy mistake or cascade incident takes service below contracted uptime; refunds + churn.

name: Secret leak via repo or build
description: API keys, database credentials, or signing keys committed to repo or leaked through build logs / container image. Used for lateral movement.
